mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE crossing above 10% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 10% but SPX shows positive returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE and PAYEMS together indicate labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Both UNRATE and PAYEMS rise but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 4% during tightening signals higher rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% but SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO growth indicates strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is positive but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 220 indicates high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 220 but SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST and RSAFS increases indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS increase but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, low UNRATE signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE is low but SPX returns are negative in >50% of late-cycle cases.
